blocks.en: 82 Systemic Light Chain Amyloidosis Monique Minnema and Stefan Schönland
blocks.zh: 82 全身性輕鏈類澱粉沉積症 — Monique Minnema、Stefan Schönland
blocks.note: 來源：The EBMT Handbook（2024），各章作者如上。繁體中文為 AI 翻譯改作，未經人工專科校訂。

blocks.en: 82.1 Definition and Epidemiology Systemic light chain (AL) amyloidosis is a protein misfolding and deposition disorder with an incidence of 5–10 persons per million per year. Clonal plasma cells or rarely B cells produce immunoglobulin light chains with the potential to misfold. These light chains are deposited as extracellular amyloid fibrils in peripheral tissues and cause morbidity and mortality. Organs most frequently involved are the heart, kidney, liver, autonomic and peripheral nervous system, gastrointestinal tract, and soft tissue.
blocks.zh:
82.1 定義與流行病學
全身性輕鏈（AL）類澱粉沉積症是蛋白質錯誤摺疊與沉積疾病，每年發生率約每百萬人 5–10 例。克隆性漿細胞，或少數情況下的 B 細胞，產生可能錯誤摺疊的免疫球蛋白輕鏈。這些輕鏈以細胞外類澱粉纖維沉積於周邊組織，造成疾病與死亡。最常受累器官為心臟、腎臟、肝臟、自律與周邊神經系統、胃腸道及軟組織。

blocks.en: 82.2 Diagnosis AL amyloidosis should be suspected in any patient with a monoclonal gammopathy and a compatible clinical syndrome such as heart failure with a preserved ejection fraction, nephrotic range proteinuria, unexplained weight loss, peripheral neuropathy, a bleeding diathesis, or carpal tunnel syndrome. Gammopathy work-up should include a serum-free light chain (FLC) assay, immunofixation of serum and urine, bone marrow cytology, flow cytometry, histology and iFISH, and a full-body scan to exclude bone lesions due to symptomatic multiple myeloma (MM). Amyloidosis is diagnosed by histopathology with Congo red staining and the typical apple-green birefringence under polarized light. Screening biopsies such as abdominal fat, salivary gland, upper GI tract, or bone marrow as well as symptomatically involved organs can be utilized (Palladini et al. 2020). The amyloid subtype (i.e., AL, ATTR, AA, or another even more rare subtype) has to be further confirmed by immunohistochemistry, immune electron microscopy, or laser microdissection and mass spectrometry. Besides the more common systemic AL amyloidosis, this type of amyloidosis can also occur as a local presentation with a very good prognosis, for example, in the pharynx or bladder, and requires another treatment approach which will not be discussed in this chapter.
blocks.zh:
82.2 診斷
單株免疫球蛋白病患者若出現相符臨床症候，如射出分率保留的心衰竭、腎病範圍蛋白尿、不明原因體重減輕、周邊神經病變、出血傾向或腕隧道症候群，應懷疑 AL 類澱粉沉積症。檢查應包括血清游離輕鏈（FLC）、血清與尿液免疫固定、骨髓細胞學、流式細胞儀、組織學與 iFISH，以及全身影像，以排除症狀性多發性骨髓瘤（MM）造成的骨病灶。
診斷依組織病理 Congo red 染色及偏光下典型蘋果綠雙折射。可採腹部脂肪、唾液腺、上消化道、骨髓等篩檢性切片，或對有症狀受累器官取樣（Palladini et al. 2020）。類澱粉亞型（AL、ATTR、AA 或其他更罕見型）須進一步以免疫組織化學、免疫電子顯微鏡，或雷射微切割與質譜確認。
除較常見的全身性 AL 外，也可能局限表現於咽部或膀胱等處，預後很好；此類需要不同治療，本文不討論。

blocks.en: 82.3 Classification AL amyloidosis can be classified by the origin of the underlying bone marrow disease: a clonal plasma cell or more rarely lymphoid dyscrasia, which is often an IgM related AL amyloidosis. Plasma cell dyscrasias can further be divided into monoclonal gammopathy, smoldering MM, and symptomatic MM among other things depending
blocks.zh:
82.3 分類
AL 可依潛在骨髓疾病來源分類：克隆性漿細胞異常，或較罕見且常與 IgM 相關的淋巴細胞異常。漿細胞異常可依克隆大小等因素，再分為單株免疫球蛋白病、緩進型 MM 及症狀性 MM，分類取決於

blocks.en: 82.4 Risk Factors and Prognostic Scores The underlying bone marrow disease as well as organ damage-related biomarkers can be utilized to stratify patients into risk groups. A bone marrow plasma cell infiltration above 10% and a high difference between involved and uninvolved serum-free light chain (dFLC) are negative prognostic factors for overall survival. Comparable to MM genetic aberrations can be detected on iFISH in plasma cell dyscrasias and be utilized to predict response to specific treatments (e.g., in patients with translocation (11;14) HDM/HCT is more effective) (Palladini et al. 2020). Commonly used is the cardiac biomarker based classification from the Mayo clinic with the European modification. This staging system uses the biomarkers NT-ProBNP and cardiac troponins (cTnI, cTnT) measured at diagnosis. This classification system with stages I, II, IIIa, and IIIb is strongly related with survival and also provides guidance for the intensity of treatment that patients can tolerate. For patients with renal involvement, total proteinuria/24 h and estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) can anticipate the risk for terminal renal failure. The depth of response is also a significant prognostic factor as patients achieving an amyloidosis VGPR (dFLC below 40 mg/L) or CR after treatment have a significantly better outcome (Palladini et al. 2020).
blocks.zh:
82.4 危險因子與預後評分
潛在骨髓疾病與器官損傷相關生物標記，可用於風險分層。骨髓漿細胞浸潤 >10%，以及受累與未受累血清游離輕鏈差值（dFLC）高，均為 OS 不良因子。與 MM 類似，iFISH 可檢出遺傳異常並預測特定治療反應；例如 t(11;14) 患者的高劑量 melphalan／HCT 較有效（Palladini et al. 2020）。
常用分期為 Mayo Clinic 心臟生物標記分類的歐洲修訂版，以診斷時 NT-proBNP 與心肌 troponin（cTnI、cTnT）分為 I、II、IIIa、IIIb，與存活高度相關，也可指引患者能耐受的治療強度。
腎臟受累者可依 24 小時總蛋白尿與估算腎絲球過濾率（eGFR）預測末期腎衰竭風險。反應深度亦為重要預後因子：達到類澱粉沉積症 VGPR（dFLC <40 mg/L）或 CR 者，結果顯著較佳（Palladini et al. 2020）。

blocks.en: 82.5 First-Line Treatment Risk-adapted treatment is strongly preferred and many patients are fragile and do not tolerate standard used dosing regimens (see Table 82.1). Three categories are defined with low-risk patients, transplant eligible, being a minority (≤20%). High-risk patients are defined by Stage IIIb and/or having NYHA class III or IV heart disease. Other factors to consider are age, performance status, eGFR, neuropathy and systolic blood pressure. Frequent assessments of hematological response during treatment are needed, and the goal is to achieve a CR or VGPR as a deep hematologic response is closely related to survival. Patients having a hematologic response may gradually achieve an organ response.
blocks.zh:
82.5 第一線治療
強烈建議依風險調整治療；許多患者脆弱，無法耐受標準劑量（見表 82.1）。風險分三類，低風險且符合移植條件者僅占少數（≤20%）。高風險定義為 IIIb 期及／或 NYHA III、IV 級心臟病；另應考量年齡、體能狀態、eGFR、神經病變及收縮壓。治療期間須頻繁評估血液學反應，目標為 CR 或 VGPR，因深度血液學反應與存活密切相關。取得血液學反應後，器官反應可能逐漸出現。

blocks.en: In 2021, the EMA approved the first-line treatment of Daratumumab-Cyclosphosphamide- Bortezomib-Dexamethason with Daratumumab maintenance for patients with cardiac stages I, II, IIIa after the publication of the Andromeda study (Kastritis et al. 2021). This study demonstrated a better deep hematological response as well as better major organ detoriation and hematologic progression free survival in the daratumumabtreated patients. At 6 months, more cardiac and renal responses occurred in the daratumumab group than in the control group (41.5% vs. 22.2% and 53.0% vs. 23.9%, respectively). This regimen is the current preferred treatment regimen for most patients, but excludes cardiac IIIb patients (Wechalekar et al. 2023). Transplant eligible patients can still receive AutoHCT, especially when the hematological response is less than a VGPR, because the long-term data of transplant are excellent with a low relapse rate in patients in CR (Sanchorawala et al. 2022).
blocks.zh: 2021 年，Andromeda 研究發表後（Kastritis et al. 2021），EMA 核准 daratumumab＋cyclophosphamide＋bortezomib＋dexamethasone，後接 daratumumab 維持，作為心臟 I、II、IIIa 期患者的第一線治療。研究顯示 daratumumab 組有更好的深度血液學反應，以及較佳的重大器官惡化及血液學無進展存活。6 個月時，其心臟與腎臟反應均較對照組多，分別為 41.5% 對 22.2%，以及 53.0% 對 23.9%。此為目前多數患者的首選方案，但不包括心臟 IIIb 期（Wechalekar et al. 2023）。符合移植條件者仍可接受自體 HCT，尤其血液學反應未達 VGPR 者；移植長期資料極佳，CR 患者復發率低（Sanchorawala et al. 2022）。

blocks.en: 82.6 Second-Line Treatment There is no positive randomized trial data to guide treatment at relapse. Patients with a good duration of response who tolerate initial treatment well may be retreated with the same initial regimen. Patients with a short response are best treated with an alternative agent combination using agents to which the patient has not been exposed, autoHCT or in a clinical trial tailored to the individual patient in terms of their age, comorbidities, extent of organ involvement, and the patient’s wishes. Lenalidomide and pomalidomide can be considered in relapsed disease although data on durability of response are limited (Basset et al. 2021). Toxicity with lenalidomide is a significant issue, and it is recommended to start at a dose of 15 mg daily, with further dose reduction based on glomerular filtration rate (GFR) (Basset et al. 2021). Patients with t(11;14) have a very high chance for reaching a VGPR or CR with venetoclax (Premkumar et al. 2021) with a reasonable toxicity making this treatment very appealing.
blocks.zh:
82.6 第二線治療
復發治療尚無陽性隨機試驗資料可供指引。初治耐受良好且反應持續較久者，可再用原方案；反應短者宜改用未曾使用藥物的組合、自體 HCT 或臨床試驗，並依年齡、共病、器官受累與意願個別調整。
復發時可考慮 lenalidomide 或 pomalidomide，但反應持續性的資料有限（Basset et al. 2021）。Lenalidomide 毒性是重要問題，建議由每日 15 mg 起始，再依 GFR 減量（Basset et al. 2021）。t(11;14) 患者使用 venetoclax 達 VGPR／CR 的機率很高，且毒性可接受，因此具吸引力（Premkumar et al. 2021）。

blocks.en: 82.7 Autologous HCT 82.7.1 Indication Eligibility criteria for autoHCT are variable depending on the transplanting center. However, the usual eligibility criteria include age ≤ 70 years, performance status 0–2, NYHA class I or II, absence of significant clinical cardiac involvement (NT pro BNP <5000 ng/L, left ejection fraction ≥45 to 50%), absence of severe orthostatic hypotension (i.e., systolic blood pressure ≥ 90 mm Hg), and eGFR >40 mL/min. Induction therapy before stem cell mobilization can be given, especially in patients who fulfill (smoldering) myeloma definition criteria, i.e., ≥10% bone marrow plasma cell infiltration.
blocks.zh:
82.7 自體 HCT
82.7.1 適應症
各中心資格標準不盡相同。通常包括年齡 ≤70 歲、體能狀態 0–2、NYHA I／II 級、無明顯臨床心臟受累（NT-proBNP <5000 ng/L，左心室射出分率 ≥45–50%）、無嚴重姿勢性低血壓（收縮壓 ≥90 mmHg），以及 eGFR >40 mL/min。動員前可先誘導，尤其符合（緩進型）骨髓瘤定義、即骨髓漿細胞 ≥10% 者。

blocks.en: The correct selection of patients is extremely important since the mortality associated with autoHCT in AL amyloidosis can be unacceptable high if not done properly. Since the selection criteria also include the cardiac biomarkers, treatmentrelated mortality has dropped from around 20 to 2%; also see Table 82.2.
blocks.zh: 正確選擇患者極其重要，否則 AL 自體 HCT 死亡率可能高至無法接受。納入心臟生物標記篩選後，治療相關死亡率已由約 20% 降至 2%；另見表 82.2。

blocks.en: 82.7.2 Recommended Stem cell mobilization and leucapheresis can be associated with unusual morbidity, and a syndrome of hypoxia and hypotension has been described both during mobilization with G-CSF and during the leucapheresis procedure itself, probably as a result of a capillary leak syndrome triggered by G-CSF. Therefore, use of reduced doses of G-CSF (such as 10 μg/kg per day for 4–5 days) is recommended. In low-burden disease (i.e., plasma cells <10%), the use of CY mobilization chemotherapy does not seem to be necessary.
blocks.zh:
82.7.2 建議
幹細胞動員與白血球分離術可能出現特殊併發症。G-CSF 動員與採集期間皆曾出現低血氧及低血壓，可能是 G-CSF 引起微血管滲漏症候群所致。因此建議較低劑量 G-CSF，如每日 10 μg/kg、連續 4–5 天。低負荷疾病（漿細胞 <10%）似乎無須用 CY 化療動員。

blocks.en: Conditioning regimens are based on highdose MEL. The usual MEL dose is 200 mg/m² , since lower dose melphalan is associated with decreased hematological response and PFS and therefore other treatment non-transplant options may be more suitable (Cibeira et al. 2011).
blocks.zh: 預處理以高劑量 MEL 為基礎，通常為 200 mg/m²；較低劑量與較差血液學反應及 PFS 相關，因此其他非移植治療可能更合適（Cibeira et al. 2011）。

blocks.en: 82.7.3 Results Figure 82.1 shows OS of patients included in the EBMT database treated with autoHCT with a median survival longer than 10 years. In Table 82.2, the results from other publications are summarized. The use of induction therapy before HCT has been more frequently applied and seems to demonstrate better hematologic responses than HCT alone (Gustine et al. 2022).
blocks.zh:
82.7.3 結果
圖 82.1 為 EBMT 資料庫自體 HCT 患者的 OS，中位存活超過 10 年；其他文獻結果見表 82.2。移植前誘導使用日益增加，相較單獨 HCT，似乎有較佳血液學反應（Gustine et al. 2022）。

blocks.en: 82.8 Cellular Therapies The largest retrospective analysis on allo-HCT for AL amyloidosis was performed by the EBMT in 2006 (Schönland et al. 2006). Nineteen patients were analyzed. Seven patients received MAC, and eight RIC. 40% of patients died of TRM. Long-term survival and sustained CR were achieved in seven patients and were associated with chronic GVHD in the majority of them. DLI has been successfully performed in a few patients with AL amyloidosis, thereby demonstrating a potent “graft-versus-plasma cell-dyscrasia” effect. The EBMT initiated a noninterventional prospective study (NIS) for patients with AL amyloidosis undergoing allo-HCT. Preliminary results have been presented at the EBMT meeting in 2016 with improved overall survival of more than 70% after 5 years. Allo-HCT after RIC can be discussed as a treatment option for relapse after auto-HCT in patients <60 years with preserved organ functions and a HLA-identical donor. It might be a curative treatment for highly selected patients.
blocks.zh:
82.8 細胞治療
EBMT 於 2006 年進行 AL 異體 HCT 最大回顧性分析（Schönland et al. 2006），納入 19 人，其中 7 人接受 MAC、8 人接受 RIC；40% 死於治療相關原因。7 人長期存活並持續 CR，多數伴慢性 GVHD。少數 AL 患者成功接受 DLI，顯示強大的「移植物抗漿細胞異常」效應。
EBMT 另啟動異體 HCT 的非介入前瞻性研究（NIS），2016 年年會初步結果顯示 5 年 OS 已改善至 >70%。自體 HCT 後復發、年齡 <60 歲、器官功能保留且具 HLA 相合供者者，可討論 RIC 異體 HCT；對高度篩選患者可能具有治癒性。

blocks.en: To date, there are only 9 cases published (some only as abstract) by centers in Spain and Israel who have been treated with academic BCMA CAR T-cells. Efficacy and tolerability have been very good. All patients achieved CR of the underlying clonal bone marrow disorder and organ responses could be observed (Oliver- Caldes et al. 2021; Kfir-Erenfeld et al. 2022). Clinical trials are on the way to apply this treatment to a larger cohort of AL amyloidosis patients.
blocks.zh: 截至本章撰寫時，西班牙與以色列中心僅發表 9 例接受學術型 BCMA CAR T 細胞治療的 AL 病例，部分僅有摘要。療效與耐受性均佳，所有患者的潛在骨髓克隆疾病均達 CR，亦觀察到器官反應（Oliver-Caldes et al. 2021；Kfir-Erenfeld et al. 2022）。臨床試驗正展開，以將此治療用於更大的 AL 患者群。

blocks.en: Major Key Points • AL amyloidosis therapy is directed against the underlying plasma cell or B cell clone. • Deep hematological response is the goal of therapy and improves survival. • Intensity of chemotherapy has to be risk adapted.
blocks.zh:
主要重點
• AL 治療針對潛在漿細胞或 B 細胞克隆。
• 目標為深度血液學反應，並可改善存活。
• 化療強度必須依風險調整。

blocks.en: • High-dose chemotherapy with auto- HCT is still a good choice for low-risk patients treated in experienced centers. • Results from cellular therapies are encouraging and will play an important role in the future.
blocks.zh:
• 低風險患者在有經驗中心接受高劑量化療合併自體 HCT，仍是良好選擇。
• 細胞治療結果令人鼓舞，未來將扮演重要角色。
